lines.text: Many learners say: Although he is rich, but he is sad.
Better: Although he is rich, he is sad.
Although already joins the two ideas.
We went out! Although it rained, we went out.

data.wrong: Although he is rich, but he is sad.
data.right: Although he is rich, he is sad.
data.why: Although already joins the two ideas.

native.tip: हिंदी में “हालाँकि… लेकिन” दोनों बोलते हैं। अंग्रेज़ी में although के साथ but नहीं लगता।
native.caption: क्या आप भी बोलते हैं: “Although he is rich, but he is sad.” 😅 सही वाक्य है: “Although he is rich, he is sad.” ध्यान रखें: although के साथ but नहीं लगता। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “we went out”। याद रखें: although के साथ but नहीं लगता। अब अपना एक वाक्य ज़ोर से बोलिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners use both although and but, but English needs only one of them.
en.caption: Do you say: “Although he is rich, but he is sad.” 😅 The right sentence is: “Although he is rich, he is sad.” Remember: Although already joins the two ideas, so skip but. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
